lines: Shipping & Delivery Policy
Effective Date: November 8, 2026
Last Updated: November 8, 2026
Welcome to Lunaavo!
At Lunaavo, we understand how important it is to receive your kitchen appliances and dining essentials safely and within the expected delivery timeframe.
Whether you're ordering a coffee maker, food preparation equipment, or a larger kitchen appliance, our goal is to provide clear shipping information and a convenient delivery experience.
This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains how orders are processed, where we deliver, how shipping charges are calculated, and what to do if you experience a delivery issue.
1. Business Information
Store Name: Lunaavo
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
For shipping-related questions, please contact our customer support team.
2. Shipping Coverage
Lunaavo serves customers in the United States.
Orders can be shipped to eligible U.S. delivery addresses, subject to product availability, carrier service areas, and applicable shipping restrictions.
Shipping eligibility is confirmed during checkout.
Some destinations or products may have additional limitations because of package size, weight, transportation requirements, or carrier availability.
If a shipping method is unavailable for your address, please contact customer support before placing an order.
International shipping is not offered unless specifically indicated during checkout or confirmed by Lunaavo.
3. Order Processing Time
Orders are reviewed and prepared for shipment after successful payment authorization and any necessary order verification.
Standard Order Processing Time: [CONFIRM: Number of business days]
Processing may include:
* Order verification and payment confirmation.
* Product availability checks.
* Preparation and packaging.
* Shipping label generation.
* Carrier pickup arrangements.
* Additional coordination for oversized appliances.
Business days generally exclude Saturdays, Sundays, and applicable public holidays.
Orders placed outside the processing cutoff may begin processing on the following business day.
Order Processing Cutoff: [CONFIRM: Time and Pacific Time zone]
Processing time refers to the period before an order is handed over to a shipping carrier. It does not include transportation or delivery time.
4. Shipping Methods and Estimated Delivery Times
Available shipping services may vary depending on the product, delivery address, package dimensions, and carrier availability.
Standard Shipping
Estimated Transit Time: [CONFIRM: Number of business days]
Estimated Total Delivery Time: [CONFIRM: Processing + transit time]
Estimated delivery periods begin according to the applicable order processing and shipping schedule.
Delivery estimates are provided for planning purposes and may be affected by circumstances outside our reasonable control.
If a product requires a different delivery timeframe, the applicable information should be communicated in its listing, at checkout, or in your order confirmation.
Important Delivery Information
Delivery estimates may be affected by:
* Product availability.
* Shipping destination.
* Carrier operating schedules.
* Weather conditions.
* Transportation disruptions.
* Public holidays.
* Oversized or specialized freight requirements.
* Address verification or delivery access issues.
We aim to communicate material changes to the expected shipment schedule.
5. Shipping Charges
Standard Shipping Fee: [CONFIRM: Free shipping, flat rate, or calculated shipping]
Any applicable shipping and handling charges will be displayed during checkout before the order is submitted.
Shipping charges may depend on:
* Product size and weight.
* Delivery destination.
* Selected shipping service.
* Number of packages.
* Specialized handling requirements.
* Freight or oversized-item delivery arrangements.
Where a product qualifies for a shipping promotion, the applicable offer and conditions will be displayed.
Customers should review their final order summary before completing payment.
6. Large Appliances and Freight Deliveries
Certain kitchen and dining products may require additional handling because of their dimensions, weight, or installation requirements.
Examples may include larger ovens, cooktops, ranges, dishwashers, and other substantial kitchen equipment.
Depending on the product and destination, delivery may involve a specialized carrier or freight service.
Important Considerations
* Additional delivery coordination may be required.
* Some carriers may contact customers to arrange delivery.
* Access restrictions may affect delivery options.
* Standard delivery may not include carrying products inside a building.
* Installation, assembly, unpacking, or removal of existing appliances is not included unless expressly stated.
* Freight deliveries may have product-specific procedures for documenting visible damage.
Any special delivery conditions or additional charges should be disclosed before purchase.
Customers purchasing larger appliances should verify product dimensions, available access routes, and installation requirements before ordering.
7. Order Confirmation
After successfully placing an order, customers should receive an order confirmation through the email address provided during checkout.
Your confirmation may include:
* Order number.
* Purchased products.
* Billing and shipping details.
* Order total.
* Selected shipping method.
* Relevant order information.
Please review your order confirmation carefully.
If you notice incorrect shipping information, contact us as soon as possible.
An order confirmation does not necessarily mean the order has been dispatched.
8. Shipment Confirmation and Tracking
Once an order has been dispatched, available shipment information may be communicated by email or through the customer's order account.
Depending on the carrier and shipping service, this may include:
* Carrier name.
* Tracking number.
* Shipment status.
* Estimated delivery information.
* Tracking website or link.
Tracking information may take time to become active after a shipping label is created or the package is handed to the carrier.
If tracking information is not available or appears incorrect, please contact our support team.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Please include your order number when requesting tracking assistance.
9. Multiple Items and Separate Shipments
Orders containing multiple products may be delivered in separate packages.
This can occur when products have different dimensions, shipping requirements, availability dates, or fulfillment arrangements.
As a result:
* Items may arrive on different dates.
* Separate tracking numbers may be issued.
* Different carriers may handle individual packages.
* Delivery times may vary between items.
If your order arrives in multiple shipments, please check the shipment information before reporting missing items.
Contact customer support if you need clarification about the remaining products.
10. Shipping Address Accuracy
Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete shipping information during checkout.
Please verify:
* Recipient's full name.
* Street address.
* Apartment, suite, or unit number.
* City.
* State.
* ZIP code.
* Contact phone number, where required.
Incorrect or incomplete addresses may result in shipping delays or failed delivery attempts.
If you notice an error after placing your order, contact us immediately.
We will review whether the address can be updated before shipment.
Once a package has been dispatched, address changes may be restricted by the carrier.
Any additional charges resulting from an address correction or reshipment will be communicated where applicable and permitted by law.
11. Delivery Attempts and Undeliverable Packages
Shipping carriers may make delivery attempts according to their operating procedures.
If a package cannot be delivered, the carrier may:
* Attempt delivery again.
* Provide pickup instructions.
* Request additional delivery information.
* Hold the package temporarily.
* Return the package to the sender.
If your tracking information indicates a delivery problem, please contact the carrier or Lunaavo customer support.
For packages returned because of an incorrect address, failed delivery, or other circumstances, we will review the available options under our applicable policies and legal obligations.
Any potential reshipping charges will be communicated before a new shipment is arranged.
12. Delayed Shipments
We understand that timely shipping is important.
Although we aim to meet communicated shipment estimates, delays may occasionally occur.

If we determine that an order cannot be shipped within the promised timeframe, we will notify the customer and provide the applicable options, including consenting to a revised shipment schedule or canceling for a full refund, as required by law.
Where no shipment timeframe was stated, applicable federal shipping requirements still apply.
We will not require customers to accept an indefinite shipping delay contrary to their legal rights.
If your order appears delayed, please contact us at info@lunaavo.us with your order number.
13. Packages Marked Delivered but Not Received
If your tracking information shows that your package was delivered but you cannot locate it, we recommend the following steps:
1. Verify the delivery address on your order.
2. Check around the delivery location.
3. Review any delivery photographs or notifications.
4. Check with household members or building management, where appropriate.
5. Contact the carrier for additional delivery information.
6. Notify Lunaavo customer support if the package remains missing.
Please provide your order number and relevant tracking details.
We will review the available shipment information and assist with the appropriate next steps.
Any determination regarding replacement, refund, or other resolution will take account of the circumstances and applicable consumer protection laws.
14. Damaged Packages or Products
If your order arrives damaged, please contact us promptly.
We recommend retaining:
* The original packaging.
* Shipping labels.
* Product documentation.
* Photographs of the packaging.
* Photographs of the affected product.
When contacting us, please include:
Order Number: Your Lunaavo order reference.
Product Name: The affected item.
Description: A brief explanation of the damage.
Photographs: Clear images showing the issue, if available.
Our team will review the concern and explain the available options under our Returns & Refunds Policy and applicable law.
For large appliances delivered by freight, document any visible damage on the carrier's delivery paperwork when possible.
Documenting damage helps with the review process but does not eliminate rights provided by applicable law.
15. Incorrect or Missing Items
If your delivery contains the wrong product or an item appears to be missing, please contact customer support.
Include:
* Your order number.
* The item ordered.
* The item received, if different.
* Relevant photographs, where helpful.
* Any available packing slip information.
Before reporting a missing item, please check whether your order was divided into multiple shipments.
We will review the order details and provide assistance with the appropriate resolution.
16. Order Changes and Cancellations
If you need to modify or cancel an order, contact us as soon as possible.
Changes may be possible before the order enters the shipping or fulfillment process.
Once an order has been dispatched, cancellation or modification options may be limited.
If your order has already shipped, any available return options will be governed by our Returns & Refunds Policy and applicable law.
For more information, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
17. Shipping Restrictions
Some products may be subject to restrictions based on:
* Product size or weight.
* Electrical or technical specifications.
* Carrier limitations.
* Delivery location.
* Local transportation requirements.
* Applicable laws and regulations.
Certain appliances may not qualify for all shipping methods.
If a product cannot be shipped to your selected destination, the available options will be communicated during checkout or through customer support.
18. Holidays and Non-Business Days
Order processing and carrier operations may be affected by public holidays and other non-business days.
During periods of increased order volume, shipping and delivery schedules may also be affected.
Any revised estimates should be communicated when reasonably available.
Customers are encouraged to review estimated delivery information before ordering products needed by a particular date.
19. Shipping and Delivery Responsibilities
Lunaavo aims to provide accurate shipping information and assist customers with delivery-related concerns.
Customers are encouraged to:
* Provide complete shipping information.
* Review their order confirmations.
* Monitor available tracking updates.
* Respond to carrier communications when necessary.
* Contact support promptly if a delivery issue occurs.
Nothing in this policy limits any rights or remedies customers may have under applicable federal or state law.
20. Contact Us for Shipping Assistance
If you have questions about shipping, delivery, tracking, or an existing order, our customer support team is available to help.
Lunaavo
Operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Please include your order number when contacting us about a shipment.
Important: Our listed business address should not be used for product returns unless specifically authorized by customer support.
21. Policy Updates
Lunaavo may update this Shipping & Delivery Policy to reflect changes in shipping arrangements, business operations, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on our website with its updated revision date.
Changes will not override rights already established under applicable law or existing purchase agreements.
Thank You for Shopping With Lunaavo
We appreciate your trust in Lunaavo and aim to make your shopping experience clear, convenient, and dependable.
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.
https://lunaavo.us

Our Returns & Refunds Policy explains how to request a return, which products may be eligible, how refunds are processed, and what to do if you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item.
We encourage all customers to review this policy before placing an order.

lines: Returns & Refunds Policy
Effective Date: November 8, 2026
Last Updated: November 8, 2026

At Lunaavo, customer satisfaction is important to us. We understand that purchasing kitchen appliances and dining essentials online requires confidence, and we want our customers to understand their options if a purchase does not meet their expectations.
Our Returns & Refunds Policy explains how to request a return, which products may be eligible, how refunds are processed, and what to do if you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item.
We encourage all customers to review this policy before placing an order.
1. Business Information
Store Name: Lunaavo
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
For all return and refund inquiries, please contact our customer support team.
2. Return Eligibility Period
Customers may request a return within [CONFIRM: Number of calendar days] after receiving their order, subject to the eligibility requirements outlined in this policy.
The return period begins on the date the product is delivered.
To request a return, please contact our support team within the applicable return period.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Please include your order number, the product you wish to return, and the reason for your request.
Submitting a return request does not automatically authorize a return. Our team will review the request and provide instructions based on the applicable policy and legal requirements.
3. General Return Conditions
For standard change-of-mind returns, products must generally meet the following conditions:
* The return request is submitted within the applicable return period.
* The product is in its original, unused condition.
* The product has not been installed, altered, or damaged after delivery.
* All originally included components and accessories are present.
* The original packaging, manuals, and product documentation are included where reasonably required.
* The product is eligible for return under its applicable listing and this policy.
* The customer follows the provided return instructions.
Products that have been used, installed, modified, or damaged after delivery may not qualify for a standard change-of-mind return.
Different rules may apply to defective, damaged, misdescribed, or incorrectly supplied products, including rights provided by applicable law.
4. How to Request a Return
To begin a return request, follow these steps.
Step 1: Contact Customer Support
Send an email to info@lunaavo.us with the subject:
Return Request — Order #[Your Order Number]
Include the following information:
* Your full name.
* Your order number.
* The product name and model.
* The reason for the return.
* The date of delivery.
* Photographs, if relevant to the issue.
Step 2: Return Request Review
Our customer support team will review your request against the applicable return conditions.
If additional information is required, we may contact you for clarification.
Step 3: Receive Return Instructions
For eligible returns, our team will provide the applicable return shipping instructions, including the designated return destination and any necessary reference information.
Do not ship products to our Berkeley business address unless our support team specifically authorizes that destination.
Step 4: Prepare Your Return
Package the product securely to help prevent damage during transportation.
Include all required components and accessories, and follow the return instructions provided.
Step 5: Return Inspection and Resolution
Once the returned product is received, it may be inspected to confirm its condition and eligibility.
If the return qualifies for a refund, the refund will be processed according to the terms outlined below.
5. Return Shipping Costs
Return shipping responsibilities depend on the reason for the return and the applicable policy.
Change-of-Mind Returns: [CONFIRM: Customer-paid, retailer-paid, or another arrangement]
Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Products: [CONFIRM: Return shipping arrangements, subject to applicable law]
Customers will be informed of applicable return shipping requirements before being instructed to ship a product.
Some kitchen appliances are heavy, fragile, or oversized and may require specialized return transportation.
Customers should not arrange an expensive freight return without first contacting our support team.
Nothing in this section limits any return shipping rights available under applicable law.
6. Restocking Fees
Restocking Fee: [CONFIRM: No restocking fee, or specify the applicable percentage or fixed amount]
Any applicable restocking fee must be disclosed in accordance with our published terms and applicable law.
Where permitted, a restocking fee may depend on the product category and reason for the return.
Customers will be informed of any applicable deductions when their return request is reviewed.
Fees will not be imposed where prohibited by law.
7. Refund Eligibility
A refund may be available when:
* An eligible product is returned within the applicable period.
* The returned product meets the relevant return conditions.
* A product is received damaged or defective and a refund is the appropriate remedy.
* An incorrect product was supplied and a refund is required or agreed upon.
* An order is canceled before fulfillment and qualifies for a refund.
* A refund is otherwise required by applicable law.
Refund eligibility depends on the circumstances of the request and the relevant purchase terms.
Our support team will communicate the applicable resolution after reviewing the request.
8. Refund Processing
After an eligible return is received and reviewed, an approved refund will be initiated according to the following timeframe:
Refund Initiation Time: [CONFIRM: Number of business days after approval]
Refunds will generally be issued to the original payment method, unless another method is agreed upon or required by law.
Once a refund has been initiated, the time required for the funds to appear may depend on the customer's bank, card issuer, or payment provider.
Customers will be informed of the refund outcome and relevant processing information.
Important Refund Information
* Refunds are subject to applicable eligibility conditions.
* Any authorized deductions must comply with the disclosed policy and applicable law.
* Refund timing may vary depending on the payment provider.
* Certain payment reversals may follow different procedures.
* Customers should contact support if a communicated refund timeframe has passed.
If you have questions about a refund, email info@lunaavo.us with your order number.
9. Damaged Products
We understand that receiving a damaged appliance or kitchen product can be disappointing.
If your order arrives damaged, please contact our customer support team promptly after discovering the issue.
What to Provide
Please include:
* Your order number.
* The affected product name.
* A description of the damage.
* Photographs of the product, where available.
* Photographs of the packaging, if relevant.
* Any carrier documentation relating to visible delivery damage.
We may request additional information to help assess the issue.
Depending on the circumstances and applicable rights, an appropriate resolution may include a replacement, repair, refund, or another agreed remedy.
Customers should not attempt to operate appliances that appear unsafe or have sustained significant damage.
10. Defective or Malfunctioning Products
If a product is defective or develops a problem, contact our support team for assistance.
Please provide:
* Your order number.
* Product name and model number.
* A description of the issue.
* Relevant photographs or other supporting details, where practical.
Our team will review the concern and provide information about the applicable return, replacement, or warranty procedures.
Some products may also have manufacturer warranty coverage.
Warranty terms vary by manufacturer and product.
Important: For potentially hazardous issues involving electricity, gas, heating elements, or other safety concerns, stop using the product and seek appropriate qualified assistance.
This policy does not restrict any non-waivable consumer rights or remedies under applicable law.
11. Incorrect Items Received
If you receive an item different from the one you ordered, please contact us promptly.
Include your order number and photographs of the item received, where helpful.
Our team will review the order details and explain the appropriate resolution.
Where Lunaavo has supplied the wrong product, the customer will not be required to bear costs that applicable law places on the seller.
12. Missing Items or Accessories
If your order arrives with missing items or accessories, first review your shipment information to determine whether your order was divided into multiple deliveries.
If an item remains missing, contact info@lunaavo.us.
Please provide:
* Your order number.
* The product name.
* A description of what is missing.
* Any relevant packaging or delivery information.
We will review the available order details and assist with an appropriate resolution.
13. Non-Returnable Products and Exceptions
Certain products may have return restrictions based on their condition, nature, or applicable legal requirements.
For example, restrictions may apply to:
* Products that have been installed or materially altered after delivery.
* Products damaged through misuse or improper handling.
* Products missing essential components.
* Certain hygiene-sensitive items after use.
* Custom-made or specially configured products, where applicable.
* Items expressly identified as final sale, where such restrictions are lawful.
* Products outside the standard return period, unless another remedy applies.
Product-specific exceptions must be clearly disclosed where applicable.
These restrictions do not override rights relating to defective, damaged, misdescribed, or incorrectly supplied goods where applicable law provides a remedy.
14. Large Kitchen Appliances and Freight Returns
Some products, including ovens, ranges, dishwashers, cooktops, and other large appliances, may require specialized return procedures.
Because of their size, weight, or handling requirements, these items may not be suitable for ordinary parcel shipping.
Large Appliance Return Guidelines
* Contact support before arranging transportation.
* Do not independently ship a large appliance without instructions.
* Retain relevant packaging where practical.
* Provide photographs when reporting delivery damage.
* Follow the designated freight return procedure.
* Do not attempt to uninstall gas, electrical, or plumbing-connected appliances without appropriate professional assistance.
Return shipping costs and eligibility depend on the reason for the return, the product-specific terms, and applicable law.
Any applicable freight return charges will be explained before the return is arranged.
15. Exchanges
If you would like to exchange a product, please contact our support team.
Exchange Availability: [CONFIRM: Direct exchanges offered or return-and-reorder process]
Exchange eligibility may depend on:
* Product condition.
* Availability of the requested replacement.
* The reason for the exchange.
* Product-specific restrictions.
* Applicable consumer rights.
If an exchange is unavailable, our team will explain any eligible return and refund alternatives.
16. Order Cancellations
If you need to cancel an order, contact us as soon as possible.
Cancellation requests are reviewed based on the order's current processing and fulfillment status.
If the order has not been dispatched, cancellation may be possible.
If the order has already shipped, the applicable return procedures may apply.
For additional details, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
Any cancellation rights provided by applicable law remain unaffected.
17. Refused Deliveries and Undeliverable Orders
If a delivery is refused or cannot be completed, the carrier may return the shipment to its sender.
The available resolution will depend on the reason for the failed delivery, the condition of the returned shipment, and applicable legal requirements.
If an order is returned because of an incorrect address or unsuccessful delivery arrangements, any applicable reshipping or return charges will be reviewed and disclosed where permitted.
If the issue results from an error attributable to Lunaavo or its fulfillment arrangements, the resolution will reflect our responsibilities under applicable law.
18. Refunds for Orders Not Shipped
If Lunaavo cannot ship an order within the promised timeframe, customers will be provided with the notices and options required by applicable law.
Where a customer is entitled to cancel because of a shipping delay, the appropriate refund will be issued within the legally required timeframe.
We do not require customers to accept an indefinite shipping delay in violation of their legal rights.
Please refer to our Shipping & Delivery Policy for more information.
19. Unauthorized Returns
Please contact our customer support team before sending merchandise back.
Sending an item to an incorrect or unauthorized address may result in delays or difficulties locating the returned product.
The business address listed on our website is not automatically an authorized return facility.
If you need return instructions, email info@lunaavo.us.
This procedure does not remove any rights customers have under applicable law.
20. Payment Disputes and Refund Questions
If you believe a payment or refund has been handled incorrectly, please contact our customer support team so we can review the issue.
Provide your order number, the transaction date, and a description of the concern.
Customers also retain any applicable rights to contact their card issuer, bank, payment provider, or relevant consumer protection authority.
Nothing in this policy restricts lawful payment dispute or chargeback rights.
21. Consumer Rights
This policy is intended to explain Lunaavo's standard return and refund procedures.
It does not exclude, restrict, or waive consumer protections that cannot legally be limited.

Customers may have additional rights under applicable federal or state law, including rights relating to defective products, misleading descriptions, unfulfilled orders, and certain payment transactions.
Where a provision of this policy conflicts with mandatory applicable law, the law will control.
22. Contact Us
For returns, refunds, exchanges, damaged items, or other order-related concerns, please contact:
Lunaavo
Operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Please include your order number when contacting us about an existing purchase.
Return Address: Provided by customer support when applicable. Do not send merchandise to our business address without authorization.
23. Policy Updates
Lunaavo may revise this Returns & Refunds Policy to reflect changes in business operations, return procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on our website with its revision date.
Changes will not retroactively remove rights established under applicable law or the terms governing an existing purchase.
Thank You for Shopping With Lunaavo
We appreciate the opportunity to help you find kitchen and dining products for your home.
Our goal is to make shopping convenient, provide clear information, and assist customers when questions or concerns arise.
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.
https://lunaavo.us

This Order Cancellation Policy explains how to request a cancellation, when an order may be canceled, how refunds are handled, and what happens if your order has already been shipped.

lines: Order Cancellation Policy
Effective Date: November 8, 2026
Last Updated: November 8, 2026

At Lunaavo, we understand that plans can change. Whether you've ordered the wrong product, entered incorrect delivery information, or simply changed your mind, we want to make the cancellation process as straightforward as possible.
This Order Cancellation Policy explains how to request a cancellation, when an order may be canceled, how refunds are handled, and what happens if your order has already been shipped.
We encourage customers to review this policy before placing an order.
1. Business Information
Store Name: Lunaavo
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
2. Can I Cancel My Order?
Yes. Customers may request an order cancellation by contacting Lunaavo customer support.
We recommend submitting cancellation requests as soon as possible after placing an order.
Whether an order can be canceled before shipment depends on its current processing and fulfillment status, as well as any product-specific terms disclosed before purchase.
Orders that have not yet entered an irreversible fulfillment stage are generally easier to cancel.
Important: Submitting a cancellation request does not automatically mean that the order has been canceled. Our team must review the request and confirm the outcome.
Any cancellation rights provided by applicable law remain unaffected.
3. How to Request an Order Cancellation
To request a cancellation, please follow these steps.
Step 1: Contact Customer Support
Email info@lunaavo.us with the subject line:
Order Cancellation Request — #[Your Order Number]
Step 2: Provide Your Order Details
Please include:
* Your full name.
* Your order number.
* The email address used during checkout.
* The product or products you wish to cancel.
* The reason for cancellation, if you wish to share it.
Step 3: Order Status Review
Our customer support team will review the order's current status and determine whether cancellation is still possible.
Step 4: Receive Confirmation
If cancellation is approved, we will communicate the outcome and any applicable refund information.
If the order can no longer be canceled because it has already shipped or entered a non-reversible fulfillment stage, we will explain the available next steps.
4. Cancellation Before Shipment
Orders that have not yet been dispatched may be eligible for cancellation.
If your request is received before shipment, our team will review whether fulfillment can be stopped.
If cancellation is confirmed, any payment collected for the canceled items will be refunded in accordance with the applicable purchase terms and legal requirements.
If a payment was only authorized and not captured, the authorization may instead be released through the payment provider.
Please be aware that order processing can begin shortly after checkout.
We therefore recommend contacting us promptly rather than waiting until the expected shipping date.
5. Cancellation After Shipment
Once an order has been handed over to the shipping carrier, cancellation may no longer be possible.
If your order has already shipped, please contact customer support to discuss the available options.
Depending on the circumstances, you may need to wait for delivery and then request a return under our Returns & Refunds Policy.
Return eligibility, shipping responsibilities, and any applicable fees will be determined by the published policy and applicable law.
Please do not refuse delivery or send merchandise back without first contacting our support team, unless otherwise instructed or permitted by applicable law.
6. Changing or Modifying an Order
If you need to change an order rather than cancel it, contact us as soon as possible.
Possible modification requests include:
* Correcting the shipping address.
* Updating contact information.
* Changing product quantities.
* Requesting a different product model.
* Removing an item from an order.
* Correcting an order placed in error.
Our team will review whether the requested modification can be made before fulfillment.
Some modifications may require cancellation of the original order and placement of a new order.
Changes cannot be guaranteed once processing or shipping has begun.
7. Incorrect Shipping Address
Customers should carefully review their shipping information before completing checkout.
If you notice an incorrect address, contact info@lunaavo.us immediately.
Please provide your order number and the corrected address.
We will review whether the address can be updated before shipment.
Once an order has been dispatched, address changes may depend on carrier restrictions and may not be possible.
If a shipment cannot be delivered because of incorrect or incomplete information, the resolution will depend on the circumstances, applicable shipping terms, and legal requirements.
8. Cancellation of Large Kitchen Appliances
Certain kitchen appliances may require specialized handling, freight shipping, or additional fulfillment coordination.
These may include:
* Ovens and ranges.
* Cooktops.
* Dishwashers.
* Large kitchen equipment.
* Other oversized or freight-shipped products.
Cancellation options for these products may depend on whether the order has been prepared, assigned to a carrier, or dispatched.
If your order involves a large appliance, contact customer support promptly.
Our team will explain whether cancellation is possible and whether any previously disclosed, legally permitted charges apply.
Any product-specific cancellation restrictions must be communicated in accordance with applicable law.
9. Cancellation Fees
Any cancellation fee or other charge must be consistent with the terms disclosed to the customer before purchase and applicable law.
If a fee is relevant to a particular order, our team will explain its basis before proceeding.
Lunaavo will not impose undisclosed cancellation charges or fees prohibited by law.
Where a customer is legally entitled to cancel an order and receive a full refund, no inconsistent cancellation fee will be applied.
10. Refunds for Canceled Orders
When an order is successfully canceled and a refund is due, the refund will generally be issued to the original payment method.
The applicable refund amount will depend on the cancellation circumstances, the original purchase terms, and legal requirements.
Refund Processing
Once a refund is initiated, the time required for the funds to appear may vary depending on the payment provider and financial institution.
Where applicable law establishes a refund deadline, that deadline takes precedence.
Customers will be informed when the cancellation and any applicable refund have been processed.
If you have questions about a pending refund, please contact info@lunaavo.us with your order number.
11. Orders Canceled by Lunaavo
In certain circumstances, Lunaavo may need to cancel an order.
Possible reasons include:
* A product becoming unavailable.
* An inability to fulfill the order.
* Payment authorization failure.
* Unresolved payment verification issues.
* A material pricing or listing error.
* Shipping restrictions.
* Suspected unauthorized transactions.
* Other circumstances preventing lawful fulfillment.
If we cancel an order after payment has been collected, we will communicate the cancellation and issue the appropriate refund.
We will not retain payment for products we are unable to supply when a refund is required.
12. Product Availability and Out-of-Stock Orders
Although we aim to maintain accurate product availability information, inventory may change.
If an ordered product becomes unavailable, we will review the available fulfillment options.
Depending on the circumstances, we may offer the customer an opportunity to accept a revised shipment arrangement or cancel the affected order.
Any substitution must be agreed upon by the customer where required.
If the order is canceled because the product cannot be supplied, the applicable refund will be issued.
13. Shipping Delays and Cancellation Rights
We aim to communicate shipping expectations clearly.
If an order cannot be shipped within the promised timeframe, we will provide the notices and cancellation or refund options required by applicable law.
Under applicable U.S. federal requirements, customers may be entitled to cancel and receive a refund when a seller cannot meet the promised shipment timeframe.
Where no shipment timeframe was stated, the general federal 30-day shipping rule may apply.
We will not require customers to accept an indefinite shipping delay contrary to their legal rights.
For additional information, please review our Shipping & Delivery Policy.
14. Duplicate or Accidental Orders
If you accidentally place the same order more than once, contact us immediately.
Please provide the relevant order numbers and explain which order you wish to cancel.
We will review their fulfillment status and attempt to stop the unintended order where possible.
If an order has already shipped, the applicable return procedures may apply.
15. Promotional Orders and Discount Codes
Orders placed using promotional discounts or coupon codes are subject to the terms of the applicable offer.
If a promotional order is canceled, the refund will generally reflect the amount actually paid for the canceled products, subject to applicable legal requirements.
Discount codes may not be reusable after cancellation unless the promotion's terms allow it.
If you have questions about a promotional purchase, contact our support team.
16. Partial Order Cancellations
If your order contains multiple items, you may request cancellation of one or more items without necessarily canceling the entire order.
Partial cancellation availability depends on the fulfillment status of the affected products.
If a partial cancellation is approved, we will communicate the resulting order changes and applicable refund.
Any adjustment to shipping charges, taxes, or promotional eligibility will follow the original purchase terms and applicable law.
17. Payment Authorization and Pending Charges
When an order is placed, your payment provider may authorize or process the transaction.
If an order is canceled before payment capture, the authorization may be released rather than refunded as a completed charge.
Your bank or card issuer determines how long a released authorization remains visible as pending.
If payment has already been captured, any refund due will be processed through the applicable payment method.
For payment-related concerns, contact Lunaavo customer support or your payment provider.
18. Cancellation Requests Outside Business Hours
Customers may submit cancellation requests by email or through available website support channels outside regular business hours.
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Requests requiring manual review may be handled during regular business hours.
Submitting a message outside business hours does not guarantee that an order's fulfillment process will be stopped before it is reviewed.
For this reason, we encourage customers to contact us as soon as a cancellation is needed.
19. Consumer Rights and Payment Disputes
Nothing in this policy excludes or limits consumer rights that cannot be waived under applicable federal or state law.
Customers retain any applicable rights relating to:
* Unfulfilled orders.
* Delayed shipments.
* Incorrect or defective products.
* Unauthorized charges.
* Refunds required by law.
* Lawful payment disputes or chargebacks.
If you believe an order or cancellation has been handled incorrectly, please contact our support team.
You may also exercise any rights available through your bank, payment provider, or relevant consumer protection authority.
20. Contact Us for Cancellation Assistance
If you need to cancel or modify an order, please contact us using the information below.
Lunaavo
Operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
Website: https://lunaavo.us
Important: Our listed business address is not automatically an authorized product return location. Contact support before mailing any merchandise.
21. Changes to This Policy
Lunaavo may update this Order Cancellation Policy to reflect changes in business operations, fulfillment procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
The most recent version will be published on our website with an updated revision date.
Changes will not retroactively remove rights established under applicable law or the terms governing an existing purchase.
We're Here to Help
We understand that circumstances can change after placing an order.
Our goal is to provide clear cancellation information, explain your available options, and help resolve order-related concerns.
If you need assistance, please contact our customer support team.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.

lines: Payment Methods & Payment Policy
Effective Date: November 8, 2026
Last Updated: November 8, 2026
Secure, Simple & Convenient Payments at Lunaavo
At Lunaavo, we believe purchasing kitchen appliances and dining essentials should be straightforward, convenient, and transparent.
Whether you're upgrading your kitchen, purchasing a coffee maker, or ordering specialized cooking equipment, we want you to understand your payment options before completing your purchase.
This Payment Policy explains how payments are handled, which payment methods may be available, how billing information is processed, and what to do if you encounter a payment-related issue.
Official Website: https://lunaavo.us
1. Accepted Payment Methods
Lunaavo provides the payment options displayed through our website's checkout.
The methods available for a particular purchase may vary depending on the payment services currently enabled, the transaction, and any applicable eligibility requirements.
Customers can view and select from the supported payment options before submitting an order.
Credit & Debit Cards
Where enabled at checkout, customers may pay using eligible credit or debit cards.
Card acceptance depends on the payment provider, issuing bank, and transaction requirements.
Digital Wallets
Digital wallet payment options may be available when supported by our checkout and the customer's device or browser.
Only digital wallets displayed during checkout are available for use.
Other Payment Options
Additional payment methods, including installment or deferred-payment services, are available only when expressly displayed and offered through our checkout.
Any such payment method is subject to its provider's eligibility criteria, terms, and approval requirements.
Important: Lunaavo does not guarantee the availability of any specific payment method unless it is displayed as an available option during checkout.
2. Payment Currency
All prices on Lunaavo are displayed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise indicated.
The final amount payable will be shown during checkout.
If your payment account uses a different currency, your bank or payment provider may apply currency conversion rates or additional charges.
Any such charges imposed independently by your financial institution are governed by its terms.
3. Secure Payment Processing
Protecting customer payment information is an important part of our shopping experience.
Lunaavo uses the payment processing services integrated with our website to handle online transactions.
Payment information is processed according to the applicable payment provider's systems, security practices, and terms.
Important Payment Security Information
For your protection:
* Complete payments through the official Lunaavo checkout.
* Verify that you are visiting https://lunaavo.us.
* Do not share your payment card PIN or security codes through email or chat.
* Never send complete card numbers to customer support.
* Avoid entering payment details through suspicious links.
* Contact us if you receive an unexpected payment request claiming to be from Lunaavo.
We will not ask you to disclose your online banking password or complete payment card credentials through ordinary customer support communications.
For more information about personal information handling, please review our Privacy Policy.
4. How the Payment Process Works
When you place an order through Lunaavo, the checkout process generally follows these steps.
Step 1: Select Your Products
Browse our Kitchen & Dining collection and add your selected products to your shopping cart.
Step 2: Review Your Order
Confirm the products, quantities, prices, and applicable charges.
Step 3: Enter Billing and Shipping Information
Provide accurate information to help process your order and arrange delivery.
Step 4: Choose a Payment Method
Select one of the payment options available during checkout.
Step 5: Complete Payment
Follow the instructions provided by the applicable payment service.
Step 6: Receive Order Confirmation
After your order is successfully submitted, you should receive confirmation through the contact information provided at checkout.
An order confirmation does not necessarily mean that the order has been shipped.
5. Payment Authorization and Verification
Payment transactions may be subject to authorization and verification by the applicable payment provider or issuing financial institution.
Depending on the payment method, funds may be authorized, captured, or otherwise processed at different stages of the transaction.
Some orders may require additional review before fulfillment.
Verification procedures may be used to address:
* Potentially unauthorized transactions.
* Incorrect billing information.
* Payment processing errors.
* Unusual transaction activity.
* Other payment-related security concerns.
If additional information is required, our support team may contact you through an appropriate channel.
Customers should never provide passwords, complete card numbers, or sensitive authentication codes to customer support.
6. Billing Information
Customers are responsible for providing accurate billing information during checkout.
This may include:
* Full billing name.
* Billing address.
* Contact information.
* Payment details entered through the checkout service.
Incorrect or incomplete billing information may cause a transaction to be declined or delayed.
If you notice an error in your order information, contact us as soon as possible.
7. Payment Declined or Unsuccessful
Occasionally, a payment may not be completed successfully.
Common reasons include:
* Incorrect payment information.
* Insufficient available funds.
* Expired payment cards.
* Bank or card issuer restrictions.
* Billing address mismatches.
* Payment verification requirements.
* Temporary technical issues.
* Payment provider limitations.
What Should I Do If My Payment Fails?
We recommend the following:
1. Review the payment information entered.
2. Confirm that your payment method is active and eligible.
3. Check whether your bank requires transaction authorization.
4. Contact your bank or payment provider if the transaction was declined.
5. Try another available payment method if appropriate.
6. Contact Lunaavo customer support if the issue continues.
Before attempting payment again, check whether an order confirmation was created to avoid accidental duplicate purchases.
Customer Support: info@lunaavo.us
8. Pending Charges and Payment Holds
In some cases, your bank or payment provider may display a pending transaction even if an order was not completed.
A pending authorization is not necessarily a completed charge.
The time required for a pending authorization to be released depends on the payment provider and issuing financial institution.
If you notice an unexpected pending transaction, contact us with the transaction date, amount, and any related order number.
Please do not send complete payment card details.
9. Pricing, Taxes and Checkout Charges
We aim to present product pricing and applicable charges clearly before customers complete their purchases.
The final checkout amount may include:
* Product prices.
* Applicable sales taxes.
* Shipping charges, if any.
* Other charges disclosed before payment, where applicable.
Prices are displayed in USD unless otherwise stated.
Customers should review their complete order summary before submitting payment.
Pricing Errors
If a material pricing or listing error is identified, Lunaavo may need to review the affected order.
Any cancellation, correction, or refund will be handled in accordance with the applicable purchase terms and legal requirements.
We will not charge customers an increased price without obtaining any consent required by law.
10. Discounts and Promotional Codes
Lunaavo may offer promotional discounts from time to time.
When a promotional code is available, customers can enter it in the designated checkout field.
Promotions may be subject to:
* Expiration dates.
* Eligible products.
* Minimum purchase requirements.
* Usage restrictions.
* Other published promotional conditions.
Discounts cannot necessarily be combined unless expressly permitted.
If a promotional code does not work, verify its conditions or contact customer support.
11. Refunds and Payment Reversals
If an order qualifies for a refund under our Returns & Refunds Policy, Order Cancellation Policy, or applicable law, the refund will generally be issued through the original payment method.
The applicable refund amount and timing depend on the circumstances of the transaction and relevant legal requirements.
Refund Processing
Once an eligible refund has been approved and initiated, the time required for funds to appear may depend on:
* The original payment method.
* The payment processor.
* The issuing bank.
* Applicable payment network procedures.
Customers will be informed of the relevant refund outcome.
For more information, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
12. Canceled Orders and Payments
If an order is successfully canceled before shipment, any payment collected will be handled according to the applicable cancellation terms and legal requirements.
Depending on the transaction status, the payment may be refunded or an existing authorization may be released.
If an order has already shipped, the applicable return procedures may apply.
For additional details, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
13. Duplicate Charges
If you believe you have been charged more than once for the same order, please contact customer support.
Include:
* Your order number, if available.
* The transaction date.
* The amount involved.
* A description of the issue.
* A screenshot showing the relevant transactions, with sensitive information concealed, if helpful.
Our team will review the available order and payment records.
Some apparent duplicate charges may involve temporary authorizations rather than multiple completed payments.
If a duplicate payment is confirmed, we will explain the appropriate resolution.
14. Unauthorized Transactions
If you notice a payment you do not recognize, contact your bank or payment provider promptly.
You may also notify Lunaavo customer support so we can review any associated order information available to us.
For security reasons, we may request limited information necessary to identify the transaction.
We will not ask for your payment card PIN, online banking password, or complete security credentials.
Nothing in this policy limits your applicable rights to dispute unauthorized transactions.
15. Payment Disputes and Chargebacks
We encourage customers to contact our support team if they experience a payment or order-related problem.
Our team can help review concerns involving:
* Incorrect charges.
* Duplicate payments.
* Unrecognized transactions.
* Refund status.
* Canceled orders.
* Billing discrepancies.
Customers retain all applicable rights to contact their card issuer, bank, payment provider, or relevant consumer protection authority.
Nothing in this policy restricts lawful payment disputes or chargeback rights.
16. Payment Method Availability
Available payment methods may change as our payment services or checkout arrangements are updated.
A payment method previously offered may not always be available for future transactions.
Payment eligibility may also depend on the customer's financial institution, payment provider, device, or transaction characteristics.
The checkout page provides the available payment options for the specific purchase.
Lunaavo does not require customers to use a payment method that is not supported through its authorized checkout process.
17. Avoiding Payment Scams
To help protect your information, we recommend following these precautions:
* Purchase only through our official website.
* Verify the website address before entering payment information.
* Be cautious of unexpected messages requesting additional payments.
* Never share account passwords or one-time authentication codes.
* Contact us directly if a payment request appears suspicious.
Official Website: https://lunaavo.us
Official Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent Lunaavo, please contact us through our published support channels.
18. Contact Us for Payment Assistance
If you have questions about payments, billing, checkout errors, or refunds, our customer support team is available to help.
Store Name: Lunaavo
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Website: https://lunaavo.us
For payment-related inquiries, please provide your order number when available.
19. Related Store Policies
For additional information, please review:
Shipping & Delivery Policy
https://lunaavo.us/shipping-policy/
Returns & Refunds Policy
https://lunaavo.us/return-and-refund-policy/
Order Cancellation Policy
https://lunaavo.us/cancellation-policy/
Privacy Policy
https://lunaavo.us/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service
https://lunaavo.us/terms-of-service/
These policies provide additional details about purchasing, order fulfillment, customer rights, and information handling.
20. Changes to This Payment Policy
Lunaavo may update this Payment Policy to reflect changes in supported payment methods, business operations, checkout procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on our website with an updated revision date.
Changes will not retroactively remove rights established under applicable law or the terms governing an existing purchase.
Shop With Confidence at Lunaavo
At Lunaavo, we want customers to enjoy a convenient shopping experience with clear pricing, accessible payment information, and helpful customer support.
Whether you're purchasing everyday kitchen essentials or specialized cooking equipment, we're here to help with questions about your order or payment.
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.
https://lunaavo.us

intro: Reliable Support for Your Kitchen & Dining Essentials
At Lunaavo, we understand that kitchen appliances and cooking equipment are important investments in your home.
Whether you've purchased an espresso machine, food processor, countertop oven, dishwasher, or another kitchen essential, having access to accurate product information and dependable support matters.
pages.description: At Lunaavo, we understand that kitchen appliances and cooking equipment are important investments in your home.
lines: Warranty & Product Support
Effective Date: November 8, 2026
Last Updated: November 8, 2026
Reliable Support for Your Kitchen & Dining Essentials
At Lunaavo, we understand that kitchen appliances and cooking equipment are important investments in your home.
Whether you've purchased an espresso machine, food processor, countertop oven, dishwasher, or another kitchen essential, having access to accurate product information and dependable support matters.
Our goal is to help customers understand the warranty coverage available for their products, identify appropriate troubleshooting resources, and navigate product-related concerns.
This page explains how product warranties work, how to request assistance, and what to do if your purchase develops a problem.
Need assistance? Contact us at info@lunaavo.us.
1. Our Commitment to Product Support
We believe that customer care should extend beyond the checkout process.
Lunaavo aims to provide clear information and accessible assistance when customers have questions about their purchased products.
Our product support priorities include:
* Helping customers locate available warranty information.
* Assisting with questions about product specifications.
* Providing guidance on applicable manufacturer support procedures.
* Reviewing concerns about damaged, defective, or incorrect products.
* Helping customers understand available return or replacement options.
* Providing information about compatible accessories where available.
* Communicating relevant product support procedures clearly.
Warranty coverage and available remedies depend on the product, its applicable warranty terms, the circumstances of the issue, and relevant consumer protection laws.
2. Understanding Product Warranty Coverage
Warranty coverage varies depending on the product, manufacturer, and any warranty expressly provided with the purchase.
Some products may include a manufacturer's limited warranty, while others may have different coverage terms or no separate written warranty.
Lunaavo does not provide a universal warranty period covering every product unless expressly stated.
Before purchasing, customers should review the warranty information available on the product listing or in the applicable manufacturer's documentation.
Warranty Information May Include
* Warranty provider.
* Coverage duration.
* Eligible defects or malfunctions.
* Parts and labor coverage.
* Repair or replacement procedures.
* Registration requirements, if applicable.
* Exclusions and limitations.
* Instructions for submitting a claim.
Where warranty information is unclear, customers may contact Lunaavo for assistance.
3. Manufacturer Warranty
Certain kitchen appliances may be accompanied by a warranty provided by their manufacturer.
Manufacturer warranties are governed by the specific terms issued by the applicable warranty provider.
Depending on those terms, available remedies may include repair, replacement, replacement parts, or another specified resolution.
How to Check Manufacturer Warranty Coverage
1. Locate your product's brand and model number.
2. Review the warranty documentation supplied with the product.
3. Check the manufacturer's official support resources.
4. Retain your Lunaavo order confirmation as proof of purchase.
5. Contact Lunaavo if you need help identifying the relevant support information.
Manufacturer warranty availability and eligibility should not be assumed solely because a product is sold on our website.
If a manufacturer warranty applies, its terms determine the coverage it provides, subject to applicable law.
4. What May Be Covered Under a Warranty?
Depending on the applicable warranty, coverage may include certain manufacturing defects, defective components, or malfunctions occurring under normal intended use.
Examples of issues that may qualify under some warranties include:
* Manufacturing defects.
* Faulty electrical components.
* Defective mechanical parts.
* Product malfunctions caused by covered defects.
* Certain failures occurring during the stated warranty period.
These examples are illustrative and do not establish coverage for every Lunaavo product.
The actual warranty document determines the specific coverage and exclusions.
5. What May Not Be Covered?
Warranty exclusions vary by manufacturer and product.
Depending on the applicable terms, exclusions may involve:
* Accidental or cosmetic damage.
* Misuse or improper operation.
* Unauthorized modifications.
* Improper installation.
* Damage caused by incompatible electrical connections.
* Normal wear and tear.
* Failure to follow manufacturer maintenance instructions.
* Damage caused by unsuitable cleaning methods.
* Commercial use of products intended for household use.
* Damage from external events, where excluded.
A particular exclusion applies only when supported by the relevant warranty terms and applicable law.
Important: Warranty exclusions do not automatically eliminate any separate rights customers may have regarding defective, misdescribed, or incorrectly supplied products.
6. How to Request Warranty Assistance
If you believe your product has developed a defect or malfunction, follow the steps below.
Step 1: Gather Your Product Information
Prepare the following details:
* Lunaavo order number.
* Product name.
* Brand and model number.
* Purchase date.
* Description of the problem.
* Photographs or videos, if relevant and safe to obtain.
* Available warranty documentation.
Step 2: Contact Lunaavo Customer Support
Email info@lunaavo.us with the subject:
Warranty Support Request — Order #[Your Order Number]
Explain the issue and include the relevant product information.
Step 3: Initial Review
Our team will review the information provided and identify the appropriate next steps.
Depending on the product and issue, this may involve checking available warranty documentation, reviewing an order-related concern, or identifying the relevant manufacturer support channel.
Step 4: Follow the Applicable Claim Procedure
If a warranty applies, the warranty provider may require additional information, product inspection, or another step described in its terms.
We will explain any support information available to us.
Step 5: Resolution
The available resolution depends on the applicable warranty, the product's condition, the nature of the issue, and any consumer rights established by law.
A repair, replacement, refund, or other remedy is not guaranteed unless required by the applicable terms or law.
7. Product Troubleshooting Assistance
Before requesting a warranty claim, customers may find it helpful to review the product's operating instructions and manufacturer's troubleshooting resources.
Some issues can be related to product settings, installation requirements, maintenance, or incorrect operation.
Common Areas to Check
Power and Electrical Requirements
Confirm that the appliance is connected according to the manufacturer's instructions and that the power supply is suitable.
Operating Instructions
Review the product manual to confirm that the appliance is being used as intended.
Product Settings
Check the relevant controls, settings, and operating modes.
Maintenance Requirements
Review any cleaning or maintenance instructions provided by the manufacturer.
Error Messages
If the product displays an error code, consult the manufacturer's official documentation.
Important Safety Notice
If an appliance shows signs of overheating, smoke, exposed wiring, gas leakage, water-related electrical hazards, or other potentially dangerous conditions, stop using it immediately.
Do not attempt unsafe repairs or bypass safety mechanisms.
For equipment involving electrical wiring, gas connections, plumbing, or other specialized systems, seek assistance from an appropriately qualified professional.
8. Damaged or Defective Products Upon Delivery
If your product arrives damaged, defective, or not as described, please contact us promptly.
We recommend providing:
* Your order number.
* The affected product's name and model.
* A description of the problem.
* Photographs of the product and packaging, where practical.
* Relevant delivery information.
Our team will review the issue and explain the applicable options under our Returns & Refunds Policy and relevant law.
For large appliances delivered by freight, document any visible damage on the carrier's delivery paperwork when possible.
Please retain the original packaging until you receive further instructions, where reasonably practical.
Do not operate an appliance that appears unsafe or seriously damaged.
9. Product Repairs and Replacements
If a product requires repair or replacement, the available options depend on the applicable warranty and circumstances.
Possible procedures may involve:
* Manufacturer troubleshooting.
* Inspection or technical assessment.
* Replacement parts.
* Authorized repair arrangements.
* Product replacement.
* Another remedy required by applicable law.
Some warranty providers may require customers to contact an authorized service center.
Customers should review the applicable warranty terms before arranging independent repairs, particularly where those repairs could affect a specific warranty claim.
Lunaavo does not guarantee on-site repair services, technician visits, or free replacement parts unless expressly included in the relevant purchase or warranty terms.
10. Replacement Parts and Accessories
Some kitchen appliances may require replacement components or compatible accessories during their useful life.
Availability depends on the product, manufacturer, and current supply options.
If you're looking for a replacement part, please provide:
* Product brand.
* Model number.
* Part name or description.
* Original order number, if available.
* Photographs, where helpful.
Our support team can assist with identifying available product information or directing you to relevant manufacturer resources.
Compatibility should be verified before purchasing or installing replacement components.
11. Installation and Setup Support
Certain kitchen appliances require specific installation procedures.
Examples include:
* Built-in ovens.
* Cooktops and ranges.
* Dishwashers.
* Range hoods.
* Garbage disposals.
* Other appliances requiring electrical, plumbing, or gas connections.
Customers should carefully review the manufacturer's installation instructions before purchasing and installing equipment.
Professional Installation
Some products may require installation by a qualified professional.
Unless expressly included in the product listing or purchase agreement, Lunaavo does not provide installation, assembly, removal of existing equipment, or on-site technical services.
Improper installation may create safety hazards and may affect warranty coverage where permitted by the applicable terms and law.
If you're unsure about installation requirements, contact us before purchasing.
12. Warranty Registration
Some manufacturers may offer product registration services.
Registration requirements and their effect on warranty coverage depend on the manufacturer's terms and applicable law.
Customers should review any registration instructions included with their product.
We recommend retaining:
* Order confirmation.
* Proof of purchase.
* Product model number.
* Serial number.
* Warranty documentation.
* Relevant support correspondence.
These records may be useful if assistance is needed later.
13. Products Purchased as Gifts
If a Lunaavo product was purchased as a gift, warranty support may depend on the relevant warranty provider's eligibility rules.
Some warranties may be transferable, while others may have limitations.
If you're seeking assistance for a gifted product, please provide the original order information where available.
Our team can help identify the applicable support procedure.
14. Commercial and Professional Use
Some kitchen equipment is designed primarily for residential use, while other products may be suitable for commercial applications.
Warranty terms may differ depending on the product's intended use.
Customers purchasing equipment for restaurants, catering businesses, commercial kitchens, or other professional environments should verify that the product is suitable for their intended application.
Do not assume that a household appliance carries commercial-use warranty coverage.
For questions about product suitability, contact our team before ordering.
15. Warranty Claims Outside the Coverage Period
If a product develops a problem after its applicable written warranty expires, customers may still contact Lunaavo for available product support information.
Depending on the product, possible options may include:
* Manufacturer technical support.
* Paid repair services offered by the manufacturer or another provider.
* Replacement components.
* Product troubleshooting resources.
* Other remedies available under applicable law.
The expiration of a written warranty does not necessarily eliminate rights that may exist independently under applicable law.
16. Warranty Support vs. Returns & Refunds
Warranty claims and standard product returns are not necessarily the same process.
Returns & Refunds
These generally concern requests to return a product under our published return conditions, including eligible change-of-mind returns and other return situations.
Warranty Support
These generally concern defects or malfunctions covered by an applicable written warranty.
A product may have separate return rights, warranty coverage, or other legal remedies.
Customers should review the relevant policies and contact support when unsure which procedure applies.
Returns & Refunds Policy: https://lunaavo.us/return-and-refund-policy/
17. Shipping Products for Warranty Assessment
If a product needs to be shipped for inspection, repair, or replacement, customers should follow the instructions provided by the appropriate warranty provider or Lunaavo support team.
Shipping responsibilities and any applicable charges depend on the relevant warranty terms, the circumstances of the claim, and applicable law.
For oversized appliances, specialized transportation may be necessary.
Do not send products to Lunaavo's Berkeley business address without receiving explicit return or service instructions.
18. Consumer Rights and Warranty Protections
Lunaavo respects applicable federal and state consumer protection requirements.
Written warranty coverage may be governed by relevant laws, including the federal Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act where applicable.
Customers may also have rights under applicable state laws, including rights relating to implied warranties, defective merchandise, and products that do not match their descriptions.
Nothing on this page is intended to exclude or restrict consumer rights that cannot lawfully be waived.
Where a warranty provision or store policy conflicts with mandatory applicable law, the law will control.
19. Customer Support Availability
If you need help with a product, warranty question, or technical concern, you can contact us through our published support channels.

21. Changes to This Policy
